Read `AGENTS.md` first. Work only from public repository state and authoritative public evidence. Never infer data rights from public availability, never introduce confidential/customer/claims/portfolio data or unapproved external dataset bytes, and never weaken validation to make a change pass. Keep rights review and scientific fitness separate. Run `python scripts/check_all.py` before handoff.
